hero.description: Powered by .NET 10 Aspire, immutable accounting with DoubleEntryGuard, FIFO perpetual valuation, and Chameleon Architecture with complete ERPNext parity.
hero.headlineSub: for organizations that refuse to cut corners.
hero.feature1Desc: Dynamically morphs vocabulary and business flows for Healthcare, Automotive, Construction, or Distribution.
hero.feature2Desc: Direct invoicing with stock reduction, advance payment allocation, and strict tax retention compliance.
hero.feature3Desc: DoubleEntryGuard guarantees at the backend that no transaction leaves the balance sheet out of balance.
hero.feature4Desc: Segregated command and query operations for instant response times under heavy concurrent loads.

chameleon.title: Chameleon Architecture in Action
chameleon.subtitle: A single centralized core that dynamically transforms its vocabulary, entities, and business flows for your industry.
chameleon.guaranteeDesc: Vocabulary changes synchronize with i18n definitions and tenant metadata without recompiling the backend or altering relational constraints.

healthcare.name: Clinical Healthcare
healthcare.description: The ERP adapts medical terminology, patient admission orders, attending physicians, and rigorous supply tracking.
healthcare.feature1: Batch and expiration tracking for pharmaceuticals
healthcare.feature2: Ward and operating room allocation linked to billing
healthcare.feature3: Dual tax retention compliance for medical services

automotive.name: Automotive & Mechanical Service
automotive.description: Tailored towards vehicles, VIN chassis numbers, assigned technicians, and spare parts quotations.
automotive.feature1: Unit identification by VIN chassis and odometer
automotive.feature2: Labor hours and consumables apportionment per job

construction.name: Construction & Civil Works
construction.description: Project-based management, job sites, quantity takeoff, subcontractors, and progress certificates.
construction.feature1: Budgeted vs actual materials and labor monitoring
construction.feature2: Heavy equipment tracking as assets and cost centers
construction.feature3: Material stockpiling and retention bonds management

distribution.name: Distribution & Logistics
distribution.description: Optimized for high-velocity inventory turnover, multi-warehouse routing, import duties, and volume billing.
distribution.feature1: Landed Cost Vouchers for freight and customs apportionment
distribution.feature2: Barcode scanning and zone-based warehouse picking

modules.title: Built with Complete ERPNext Parity
modules.subtitle: Every module is engineered to satisfy the most demanding accounting and operational standards.

accounting.title: Immutable General Ledger & Treasury
accounting.description: Hierarchical multi-level chart of accounts, trial balance, bank reconciliation, and DoubleEntryGuard ensuring zero-discrepancy balance.

selling.title: Sales & Billing (Direct Stock Update)
selling.description: Issue sales invoices with immediate stock reduction (Update Stock), credit notes, advance payments, and multi-currency support.

stock.title: Perpetual Inventory & Landed Cost
stock.description: FIFO stock valuation, serial and batch tracking, tree warehouses, and import freight cost apportionment via Landed Cost Vouchers.

manufacturing.title: Manufacturing & Multi-level BOM
manufacturing.description: Multi-tier bills of materials, workstation scheduling, production orders, and labor/overhead cost absorption.

assets.title: Fixed Assets & Automated Depreciation
assets.description: Automated straight-line monthly depreciation, asset custodianship, write-offs, and asset category capitalization.

security.title: Granular Security & Multi-Tenancy
security.description: Tenant isolation, granular DocType-level permission matrices, and Two-Factor Authentication (2FA / TOTP).

techStack.title: Modern Architecture with Zero Shortcuts
techStack.subtitle: Built on the most resilient architectural patterns of modern .NET and the Web ecosystem.
techStack.quoteText: Building a world-class ERP demands discipline: avoiding bloated frameworks, isolating ledger invariants into immutable domain models, and mathematically verifying every entry.

dotnet.title: .NET 10 & Aspire Cloud-Native
dotnet.desc: Cloud-native orchestration, OpenTelemetry observability, and clean layered domain architecture.

sql.title: System-Versioned Temporal Tables
sql.desc: Immutable system-versioned temporal audit tables, composite index tuning, and optimistic RowVersion concurrency.

cqrs.title: Strict CQRS Segregation
cqrs.desc: Segregation of command and query operations for peak throughput and complete ledger event sourcing.

frontend.title: Strictly-Typed TypeScript Frontend
frontend.desc: Lightweight Zustand state management, accessible Radix UI primitives, and modular Tailwind CSS.

cta.subtitle: Access the live preview environment with all enterprise features enabled and test the speed for yourself.
